product_overview: A simple local e-commerce demo app that allows visitors to browse products and authenticated test users to purchase items and view order history. The frontend is a React (Vite + TypeScript) app with pages for catalog, product details, login, order history and an admin UI for product management (UI-only CRUD).
core_goals: Enable visitors to browse a product catalog and view product details
Support a hardcoded test account for authentication and simulated purchases
Record purchases in a local order history view for the logged-in user
Provide a simple admin UI to add/edit/delete products in local state for demos
Keep the system runnable locally without external services

features.name: Product Catalog
features.description: Browse the list of available products on the home page and navigate to product details.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> View product list -> Click "View Details" for a product -> Navigate to /product/:id -> See product details
Navigate to / -> View product list -> Click "Buy" on a product -> See login required prompt or redirect to /login

features.name: Product Details
features.description: Display comprehensive product information (name, description, image, price, category) and allow initiating a purchase.
user_flows: Navigate to /product/:id -> See product details (name, description, image, price, category) -> Click "Buy"
Navigate to /product/:id -> See product details -> Click "Buy" -> See login required prompt or redirect to /login

features.name: User Login
features.description: Authenticate the demo test account (example@gmail.com / 123456789) so users can purchase and view orders.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill email input field with example@gmail.com -> Fill password input field with 123456789 -> Click Login button to submit -> See product catalog at / or receive logged-in state
Navigate to /login -> Fill email input field with wrong@example.com -> Fill password input field with wrongpass -> Click Login button to submit -> See error message on invalid credentials

features.name: Purchasing (Simulated Checkout)
features.description: Simulate a checkout flow that adds a purchased product to the logged-in user's local order history (no real payment).
user_flows: Navigate to /product/:id -> See product details -> Click "Buy" -> Confirm simulated checkout -> See purchase confirmation -> Navigate to /order-history -> See new order in order list
Navigate to /product/:id -> See product details -> Click "Buy" -> See login required prompt or redirect to /login

features.name: Order History
features.description: Allow authenticated users to view their past purchases stored locally in the app.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill email input field with example@gmail.com -> Fill password input field with 123456789 -> Click Login button to submit -> Navigate to /order-history -> View order list
Navigate to /order-history -> See access denied or redirect to /login when not authenticated

features.name: Admin Product Management
features.description: Admin UI to add, edit, and delete products in local application state (UI-only CRUD; changes are not persisted to a backend).
user_flows: Navigate to /admin -> Click Add product -> Fill product fields (name, description, image, price, category) -> Click Save -> See new product in admin list
Navigate to /admin -> Click Add product -> Leave required fields empty -> Click Save -> See validation error
Navigate to /admin -> Select existing product -> Click Edit -> Update fields -> Click Save -> See updated product in admin list
Navigate to /admin -> Select existing product -> Click Delete -> Confirm deletion -> See product removed from admin list (local state only)

features.name: User Login
features.description: Login with email and password credentials
user_interactions: See error message on invalid credentials

features.name: Admin Product Management
features.description: Add, edit, and delete products (UI only)

known_limitations.issue: Admin CRUD is UI-only, not connected to backend API
known_limitations.impact: Create/update/delete only modify local state, not persisted
